events.name: Netshield Workshop
events.tagline: Practical exposure to ethical hacking, networking, and system defense.
events.summary: A hands-on workshop focused on ethical hacking, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals, designed to provide participants with practical exposure to modern security concepts.
events.context: The session covered network architecture, common security vulnerabilities, ethical hacking methodologies, and real-world attack and defense techniques through interactive demonstrations. Participants gained valuable insights into securing digital systems while building a strong foundation in cybersecurity awareness and best practices.
highlights: Hands-on ethical hacking and networking labs
Network architecture and security vulnerability overviews
Real-world attack and defense simulation sessions

events.name: Noobathon
events.tagline: Beginner hackathon introducing core InfoSec and UI/UX challenges.
events.summary: A beginner-friendly hackathon focused on Information Security awareness and UI/UX, designed to introduce participants to cybersecurity concepts through hands-on challenges and collaborative problem-solving.
events.context: The event brought together 400+ participants, including 150+ students from LNCT, IISER, IES, and other institutions, fostering innovation, teamwork, and practical learning.
highlights: 400+ total participants, including 150+ from external colleges
Hands-on security challenges and collaborative problem-solving

events.name: CyberHunter 2.0
events.tagline: Advanced cybersecurity competition with real-world challenge tracks.
events.summary: CyberHunter 2.0 was an advanced cybersecurity competition featuring real-world security challenges, Capture the Flag (CTF) tasks, and problem-solving exercises.
events.context: Participants enhanced their skills in ethical hacking, cryptography, web security, and digital forensics while competing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
highlights: Hands-on exercises in ethical hacking & cryptography
Focus on web security and digital forensics under time pressure

events.name: Cyber Basics 1.0
events.tagline: Introductory cybersecurity workshop aimed at beginners.
events.summary: Cyber Basics 1.0 was an introductory cybersecurity workshop aimed at beginners interested in Information Security.
events.context: The session covered essential concepts such as cyber hygiene, networking fundamentals, common cyber threats, and basic defense techniques through interactive demonstrations and practical learning activities.
highlights: Networking basics and common cyber threat overviews

events.name: OWASP CTF
events.tagline: Vulnerability exploitation challenges based on OWASP Top 10.
events.summary: The OWASP Capture the Flag (CTF) competition challenged participants to identify and exploit common web application vulnerabilities based on the OWASP Top 10.
events.context: The event provided hands-on experience in web security, secure coding practices, and vulnerability assessment while encouraging teamwork and critical thinking.
highlights: Exploitation of OWASP Top 10 web vulnerabilities
Hands-on experience in secure coding and assessment

events.name: Cyber Hunter 1.0
events.tagline: Interactive cryptography and strategic problem-solving puzzle arena.
events.summary: Cyber Hunter 1.0 was an interactive cybersecurity challenge centered on cryptography, logical reasoning, and strategic problem-solving. Participants decoded clues, solved security puzzles, and completed multiple challenge stages in a competitive environment.
events.context: The event attracted 500+ participants, providing students with an engaging platform to test and strengthen their analytical and cybersecurity skills.
highlights: Attracted 500+ active participants testing security skills
